review_subject: Exact candidate 4 canonical 9:16 master; no aesthetic scoring of the square crop.

axes.name: Hook & retention
axes.rationale: The oversized pen and two waiting outputs create a physical promise immediately; the later report examination and persistent ink repay it. The weakest third is the opening: 6.533–37.800 seconds spends a long stretch on announcement, ownership and provenance plates before the first workflow. Those are necessary facts, but their presentation has less immediate physical consequence than the historical road-edge anchor. The cap payoff around 82.000 and completed ink mark at 97.249 remain distinct.

axes.name: Illustration craft & detail
axes.rationale: The burgundy barrel, nickel rim and nib, bevelled copper desk, paper layering and shaded fingers sustain the flat-vector material language, with the hands broadly at the props' finish level. At 39.000 and 56.500 seconds the cabinets, API route and labels are plainer than the hero pen and close desk: some broad surfaces carry only simple edge shading. This is uneven execution within the chosen style, not a request for realism.

axes.name: Motion & animation craft
axes.rationale: Consecutive strips show actual cap separation, rear posting, report comparison, nib contact and ink that survives the lift; these are meaningful state changes. The hand/pen transitions around 56.500, 81.000 and 116.500 include broad rig rotations and translucent transitional poses, which are less convincing than the contact and settle itself. The contextual cabinet and wall passages rely more on plates and camera motion than articulated physical performance; continuous background bobbing does not earn narrative-motion credit.

axes.name: Composition & staging
axes.rationale: The large pen reads in silhouette, the report and draft are visually distinct, and the closer examination and writing shots make the final actions easy to follow. At 58.267–63.082 seconds, four stacked Jumpstarter/model plates compete with the input slips and blank drafting surface; legible labels consume some of the mechanism's visual space. The hero and caption band remain readable in the reviewed 9:16 frames.

axes.name: Color & grade
axes.rationale: Oxblood, porcelain, petrol, copper and nickel create a coherent office-material world and give the pen an immediate identity. The palette is materially distinct from the recent lilac/citron task world and the historical cream/spruce crate film, despite shared warm neutrals. The repeated cream-wave background and fairly constant lighting provide less progression across the arc than the changing hero action.

axes.name: Typography & captions
axes.rationale: The Fraunces/JetBrains hierarchy and high-contrast open captions read clearly in native frames; names and the DORA/Jumpstarter distinction are explicit. The native 125.000 and 130.000 second credits fit and remain readable. The many parallel all-capital information plates, particularly in the Jumpstarter introduction, compete for equal emphasis and make the typography feel more static than the best physical passages.

axes.name: Sound design & mix
axes.rationale: The current master passes measured loudness and peak requirements (-14.33 LUFS integrated, -2.74 dBTP), with 40 scheduled SFX, 29 measured audible lifts, events in every story shot, credited music and an intentional bed reduction at 112.920 seconds. The verified cap transient at 81.985329 is aligned with the fully seated 82.000 second image. This score is based on current metrics, event coverage and encoded contact verification; I did not audition the mix and cannot substantiate a higher claim about musical phrasing, performance warmth or subjective blend.

axes.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
axes.rationale: The 16 narration lines and 204 caption cues have concrete referents. DORA's retrieval/rules route and the separate generative route are labelled by 58.267 seconds; generated sections follow at 63.082, so I do not credit a completed generative demonstration before 60. The report examination at 83.967–91.300 and draft refinement through 97.249 give the conclusion visible work. The ownership introduction and prebuilt-logic assembly are more diagram-and-label driven than the final hand actions, limiting entertainment without creating an orphan passage.

axes.name: Accuracy & sourcing
axes.rationale: The September 11 KGS announcement is framed as a company announcement, while the Army workflows are attributed to the earlier AWS account. The film distinguishes DORA's software connections and prebuilt logic from Jumpstarter's large language models, credits real preparation, and shows professional review/refinement without inventing an error, automatic award or measured net productivity. It does not extrapolate an Alaska financial return. The workflow outcome evidence remains an attributed vendor account and its mirror, not two independent audits, which limits the strength of the underlying corroboration.

axes.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
axes.rationale: KGS, Koniag and the Kodiak region are named in their actual corporate relationship. Generic office hands and mechanics avoid Native personification, cultural props and savior framing. The Alaska relevance is the named corporate connection rather than an observed local deployment or quantified resident benefit; the final source limitation keeps that narrow connection honest.

axes.name: Writing & post quality
axes.rationale: The 204-word script makes two mechanisms understandable, gives their useful output fair credit, and closes with a practical question about the professional's remaining work. The post preserves primary attribution and the same scope limits. Its opening assertion and following paragraph repeat the preparation-versus-finished-decision thesis before reaching the fresh company news, and the opening narration's context chain is less economical than the final report/draft contrast.

strongest_passage: 83.967–98.200 seconds: professional report examination leads to a distinct draft-refinement action; the persistent mark is visible after the nib lifts.
weakest_passage: 6.533–37.800 seconds: three layers of corporate and source context postpone the first workflow and depend more heavily on information plates.

evidence_viewed.historical_calibration: All five named anchor images were actually viewed. Recorded medians were treated as historical whole-film calibration, not owner aesthetic targets; no historical soundtrack listening was performed.
evidence_viewed.viewing_method: Actual image pixels inspected with view_image; motion assessed with consecutive strips and native contact frames, not source labels or a motion metric alone.

limitations: No subjective audio listening was performed. Sound assessment uses exact-current master measurements, scheduled/rendered events and the independent encoded contact receipt. ASR/name checks are supporting evidence, not a personal pronunciation audition.

This is Judge2's first full panel card. The same reviewer also performed Flow POST and therefore was already aware of its technical verification; this is not a claim of a blind review. No other current judge card was read or used to form these scores.
Claim assessment uses the current verified primary-source packet and its explicit attribution limits, not a new independent outcome audit. A mirrored vendor case study is not separate corroboration.

Image review covers all six current sheets, all eight requested consecutive strips and the listed native frames, rather than uninterrupted real-time playback of every frame. No square-crop aesthetic verdict is included.
Generic background motion can satisfy mechanical cadence without improving attention; it was not counted as meaningful action in these scores.
flow_gate_relationship: The separate required Flow POST revision 2 is ship:true for this master. This panel card neither replaces nor waives that gate.
